verdict.rationale: Langfuse's own docs say it can receive traces on a dedicated OTLP endpoint (`/api/public/otel`) and list OpenTelemetry as a first-class ingestion path alongside its native SDKs, so developers can instrument with standard OTel instead of a proprietary format. One community comment preferring Phoenix's OpenTelemetry approach reflects a preference, not a documented failure, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: evidence of exporting or forwarding traces out of Langfuse over OTLP, detail on supported OTel semantic conventions and protocols, and independent hands-on corroboration of OTLP ingestion.
